description: Unique identifier for a reconstructed linked journey containing one or more trip segments.
notes: Use with segment_order to reconstruct the ordered linked journey.

description: Unique identifier for a reconstructed single-mode trip segment.
notes: Primary segment-level identifier.

description: Sequential position of the trip segment within linked_trip_id.
notes: Assigned by sorting segments within each linked_trip_id by local trip start time.

description: Inferred travel mode for the trip segment.
notes: Values identify the segment-level travel mode.

description: Year when the trip segment starts.
notes: Exact start date is not released in sample data.

description: Month when the trip segment starts.
notes: Exact start date is not released in sample data.

description: Day of week when the trip segment starts.
notes: Monday=0 and Sunday=6.

description: 30-minute interval index within the day when the trip segment starts.
notes: 0 indicates 00:00-00:29 and 47 indicates 23:30-23:59 local time.

description: Year when the trip segment ends.
notes: Exact start date is not released in sample data.

description: Month when the trip segment ends.
notes: Exact start date is not released in sample data.

description: Day of week when the trip segment ends.
notes: Monday=0 and Sunday=6.

description: 30-minute interval index within the day when the trip segment ends.
notes: 0 indicates 00:00-00:29 and 47 indicates 23:30-23:59 local time.

description: Generalized trip origin as a Geohash-6 cell.
notes: Do not interpret as an exact address, building location, or GPS coordinate.

description: Generalized trip destination as a Geohash-6 cell.
notes: Do not interpret as an exact address, building location, or GPS coordinate.

description: Reconstructed trip duration in minutes.
notes: Derived from local trip start and end times before exact timestamps are removed; rounded to two decimal places.

description: Total reconstructed network distance for the trip segment.
notes: Distance is measured along the inferred transportation network.

description: Ordered sequence of network node identifiers representing the inferred route.
notes: Original route is retained in this build. Car and walk/bike routes use OSM node identifiers; bus and rail routes use GMNS transit node identifiers.

description: Speed values associated with route segments where available.
notes: Interpret together with route_taken and network context. Summary statistics are calculated across parsed comma-separated speed values; non-numeric tokens and the -1 placeholder are excluded.

description: Name of the boarding/access stop in the transit network.
notes: Populated for applicable transit records; generally null or empty for non-transit records.
sample_values: Monroe St @ 8375 S; Fashion Place West Station; Power Station; Ballpark Station; Redwood Rd @ 10198 S

description: Transit network node_id of the boarding/access stop.
notes: Populated for applicable transit records.

description: Name of the alighting/egress stop in the transit network.
notes: Populated for applicable transit records; generally null or empty for non-transit records.
sample_values: 3900 S @ 3290 E; Murray Central Station; Jackson/Euclid Station; South Jordan Pkwy @ 1667 W; 900 E @ 591 S

description: Transit network node_id of the alighting/egress stop.
notes: Populated for applicable transit records.

description: Population expansion weight for eligible records.
notes: Use for population-expanded aggregation; rounded to two decimal places.
